name: design
description: Design exploration rounds for marketing sites and product UI: interview the owner into a direction brief with saved references, fan it out into independent HTML variants built by different skills and models, gate first drafts with fresh-context critics that push toward each premise instead of the mean, picture every variant and place the round in a Figma file where each variant opens its live page, edit variants in the page with impeccable live, and carry what the owner wants into the next brief.
